title: Hub Phase 2 — approved delivery plan
content:
# Hub Phase 2 — approved delivery plan

Approved by Mehrdad on 18 October 2026, including the temporary TypeScript calculation and thumbnail-server amendments.

## Scope
Implement the entity workflows specified in the user-supplied Hub Phase2 Plan: projects, folders, phases, positions and physical elements, contacts, fabrication batches, printout catalog/selection, project estimation settings, allocated costs, preferences and attachments. Replace affected mock workflows with real persistence, preserve existing presentation, and implement missing forms. Rearrange the Hub navigation and provide position actions in table/card/grid views. Add related development demonstration data and remove replaced mocks.

## Delivery sequence
1. Project foundation: organization provisioning, transactionally allocated immutable numbering, contacts/customer selector, folders, project creation/list/filter/search/recent/favorites/archive.
2. Project configuration: shared creation/header-edit form, images/documents, extra addresses, preferences, estimation settings, ordered pricing adjustments and allocated costs.
3. Positions/elements: phases, position creation, all three list views and action menus, metadata, quantities, exclusion, favorites/archive and activity. Engineering-dependent features use the temporary calculation boundary below.
4. Fabrication batches: list/detail/create/archive, grouped expandable elements, assignment/removal, and eligible bulk assignment from positions/projects.
5. Printouts: full user-specified global catalog, names/categories/POSITIONS scopes/status badges, selection and contextual project/position/batch entry points. Actual generation is deferred.
6. Integrated acceptance: coherent demonstration seeds, remove replaced mocks, focused API/UI tests, builds/lint/schema checks, documentation and clearly reported limitations.

## Approved decisions
- Add necessary schema/contracts within this scope without requesting approval for each addition. Preserve existing architectural boundaries except the explicit temporary calculation exception.
- Each new Position creates exactly one physical Element while engineering is uninitialized; first engineering initialization reuses it. Quantity remains derived from non-deleted Elements; non-excluded Elements determine effective quantity. Avoid duplicate element creation.
- Project archiving hides the project and positions from active views and blocks direct edits until restoration, preserving child archive flags and existing batch membership.
- Project and Position favorites are per-user bookmarks; archive state is organization-wide.
- Recent means entity updatedAt descending with deterministic tie ordering.
- Pricing adjustments apply sequentially in displayed order to the running subtotal. Use explicit surcharge/discount and percentage, optional per-adjustment monetary cap in the selected estimation dataset's estimation currency. Keep financial values as decimal strings; do not use floating-point financial arithmetic.
- Defer number previews. Allocate numbers authoritatively within entity-creation transactions.
- Preserve contact live-identity versus copied project values, project-owned configuration snapshots/provenance, protected Standard and five built-in cost identities, and transactional deletion/unassignment rules.
- User authorizes choosing reasonable defaults and routine implementation decisions. Do not overengineer or shrink scope merely to reduce development effort. Ask only when no defensible recommendation exists.

## Explicit temporary exceptions
- Implement the calculation behavior needed by this scope in TypeScript for now, isolated in a temporary location. Every temporary calculation source file must have a header stating it must migrate to Planicore/Rust. Keep one implementation behind a stable boundary and document the migration. Do not fabricate unsupported catalog engineering behavior.
- Create a super-simple Bun static thumbnail file server in the workspace. It only reads fixed placeholder images; no generation/upload pipeline. Assign placeholder thumbnails randomly to positions and persist the choice so it does not change on every read.
- Use the user-specified printout status badges during development even though generation is deferred.

## Delivery constraints
Follow each repository's AGENTS.md and required docs; no commits, changesets or additional dependencies without their required authorization. Preserve unrelated work. Focused verification is authorized for this approved crew feature. Backend owns tenant security/persistence/concurrency. Frontend uses established SignalStore/service/gateway architecture and shared UI PrimeNG boundary. Do not implement desktop/sync or a full supplier catalog as an incidental expansion.
